goal.en: Make easy small talk with your manager and handle the check gracefully.
goal.zh: 和主管輕鬆閒聊，並得體地應對誰買單。

background: cozy bistro interior with exposed brick walls, Edison bulb pendant lights, a small wooden table set for two with two plates of pasta and water glasses, a window with afternoon sunlight

intro.en: It's the end of your third week. Ms. Wong invites you to lunch at a bistro around the corner.
intro.zh: 這是你上班第三週的最後一天。王經理約你去轉角的小餐館吃午餐。

intro.en: No meeting, no laptop. Just lunch and conversation.
intro.zh: 沒有會議，沒有筆電，只有午餐和聊天。

lines.en: So, Kai, how are you finding Maple Bay so far?
lines.zh: 那麼，凱，到目前為止你覺得楓灣這城市怎麼樣？

choices.en: I really like it. The people are friendly, and I love walking by the bay.
choices.zh: 我很喜歡。這裡的人很友善，我也很喜歡在海灣邊散步。
choices.tip: How are you finding...? 是問「你覺得……怎麼樣」，回答感受，再補一個具體的例子。

choices.en: Finding? Oh, it was easy. It's right there on the map, next to the sea.
choices.zh: 找到？喔，很容易啊。它就在地圖上，就在海邊。

lines.en: Ha! No, I mean, do you like living here?
lines.zh: 哈！不是啦，我是說，你喜歡住在這裡嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong laughs and asks again. You answer the real question, but your face stays red until dessert.
story.zh: 王經理笑著再問一次。你回答了真正的問題，但臉一直紅到上甜點。

fail.why: How are you finding...? 的 find 不是「找到」，而是「覺得、感受」。回答你的感想即可：I really like it.。

choices.en: Honestly, it's okay, but it rains too much. And the food is so expensive here.
choices.zh: 老實說還好，但雨太多了。而且這裡的食物好貴。

lines.en: Oh. Well, I grew up here, so... I guess I'm used to it.
lines.zh: 喔，嗯……我在這裡長大的，所以……大概是習慣了吧。

story.en: Ms. Wong grew up in Maple Bay and loves it. The rest of lunch feels like walking on wet pavement.
story.zh: 王經理在楓灣長大，非常愛這裡。接下來的午餐，氣氛就像走在濕滑的人行道上。

fail.why: 閒聊時一開口就抱怨，會讓氣氛變差，對方也可能正好很愛這個地方。先說正面的感受：I really like it.，有缺點可以輕鬆帶過。

lines.zh: 兩份蘑菇義大利麵！請慢用！

lines.en: Thanks! So, what do you like to do on weekends?
lines.zh: 謝謝！那你週末都喜歡做什麼？

choices.en: I've been hiking a lot lately. Have you been to Cedar Trail? The view is amazing.
choices.zh: 我最近很常去爬山。您去過雪松步道嗎？那裡的景色超美。
choices.tip: 回答之後反問一個相關的問題，對話就能自然地接下去。

choices.en: On weekends I usually work on the Harbor Café plan. I want to do my best.
choices.zh: 週末我通常都在做 Harbor Café 的企劃。我想盡全力做好。

lines.en: Every weekend? Kai, weekends are for resting. Please take a break.
lines.zh: 每個週末？凱，週末是拿來休息的。拜託你休息一下。

story.en: You wanted to look hardworking. Instead, Ms. Wong now worries you're too stressed and lightens your workload.
story.zh: 你本來想展現自己很拚。結果王經理開始擔心你壓力太大，還減輕了你的工作量。

fail.why: 在很多英語系職場，主管不會因為你週末加班而加分，反而會擔心你過勞。聊聊你的興趣，再反問：Have you been to...?。

choices.en: I like go to hiking. But sometimes I am sleep all day. I am very lazy.
choices.zh: 我喜歡去爬山。但有時候我整天都在睡覺。我很懶。

lines.en: Oh... okay. Sleep is good too, I guess.
lines.zh: 喔……好吧。睡覺也不錯啦，我想。

story.en: The conversation stops. You both focus very hard on your pasta for the next five minutes.
story.zh: 對話就此打住。接下來五分鐘，你們都非常專心地吃著義大利麵。

fail.why: like 後面接 to + 原形或 V-ing：I like hiking.，「去爬山」是 go hiking，不加 to；「整天睡覺」是 I sleep all day，不加 am。再反問一句，對話才接得下去。

lines.en: Cedar Trail! I used to hike there all the time, before my kids were born.
lines.zh: 雪松步道！我以前常去那裡爬山，在小孩出生之前。

choices.en: Oh, how many kids do you have? They must keep you busy!
choices.zh: 喔，您有幾個小孩呢？他們一定讓您忙翻了吧！
choices.tip: 接住對方主動提到的話題，自然地追問，表示你有在認真聽。

choices.en: Oh. I don't really like kids, to be honest. They're so noisy.
choices.zh: 喔。老實說，我不太喜歡小孩。他們好吵。

lines.en: Well... mine are pretty great, actually.

story.en: Ms. Wong puts her phone away. She was just about to show you photos of her kids.
story.zh: 王經理把手機收了起來。她剛才正要給你看小孩的照片。

fail.why: 對方提到自己的家人時，說不喜歡小孩等於直接潑冷水。順著話題追問：How many kids do you have?。

choices.en: Oh, nice. By the way, did you read my email about the café plan?
choices.zh: 喔，不錯。對了，您有看到我寄的那封咖啡廳企劃信嗎？

lines.en: Oh, um, not yet. I'll read it this afternoon.

story.en: Lunch turns into a meeting. Ms. Wong checks her email between bites, and the friendly chat never comes back.
story.zh: 午餐變成了會議。王經理邊吃邊看信，輕鬆的閒聊再也沒回來。

fail.why: 對方正在分享私人生活，你卻突然談公事，會讓人覺得你沒在聽。先接住話題：How many kids do you have?。

lines.en: Two girls, eight and ten. They're always running around!
lines.zh: 兩個女兒，八歲和十歲。她們總是跑來跑去的！

choices.en: That sounds busy! How do you like to relax when you get some free time?
choices.zh: 聽起來很忙！您有空的時候都怎麼放鬆呢？
choices.tip: That sounds...! 回應對方的分享，再問一個輕鬆的開放式問題，讓對方多聊一點。

choices.en: Wow, two girls running around all day? You must be so tiring!
choices.zh: 哇，兩個女兒整天跑來跑去？您一定很累吧！

lines.en: I'm tiring? Am I that exhausting to be around?
lines.zh: 我很累人？跟我相處有那麼累嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong laughs it off, but she glances at her watch twice before the check comes.
story.zh: 王經理笑笑帶過，但在帳單送來前看了兩次手錶。

fail.why: tiring 是「讓人累的」，tired 才是「感到累的」。要說 You must be so tired!，或更自然的 That sounds busy!。

choices.en: Two girls? So will you try for a boy next time? Boys are good too.
choices.zh: 兩個女兒？那您下一胎要不要拚個兒子？男生也不錯啊。

lines.en: That's... a very personal question, Kai.
lines.zh: 這個……是很私人的問題，凱。

story.en: The table goes quiet. Ms. Wong suddenly remembers a two o'clock meeting that may or may not exist.
story.zh: 餐桌突然安靜下來。王經理忽然想起一個兩點的會議，不知道是真的還是假的。

fail.why: 在很多英語系文化，生育計畫、生男生女都是很私人的話題，連親戚都不太問。聊對方的興趣就好：How do you like to relax?。

lines.en: I've got this one, Kai. My treat.

choices.en: That's very kind of you. Thank you, I really enjoyed our chat.
choices.zh: 您真是太好了。謝謝您，我很喜歡今天的聊天。
choices.tip: 主管說要請客時，大方道謝就好：That's very kind of you.，再補一句感謝這次午餐。

choices.en: No, no, no! I'll pay! Please, let me pay. Give me the check!
choices.zh: 不不不！我來付！拜託，讓我付。帳單給我！

lines.en: Um... should I just come back later?
lines.zh: 嗯……我是不是晚點再過來比較好？

story.en: You and Ms. Wong pull the check back and forth. Toby waits. The table next to you starts watching.
story.zh: 你和王經理把帳單搶來搶去。托比在旁邊等著，隔壁桌的客人都開始看了。

fail.why: 在台灣搶著付錢是禮貌，但在很多英語系文化，主管說要請客就是真心的，一直推辭反而尷尬。說 That's very kind of you. Thank you. 就好。

choices.en: Really? Then I won't be polite with you! Thank you, boss.
choices.zh: 真的嗎？那我就不客氣了！謝謝老闆。

lines.en: You won't be polite? Should I be worried?
lines.zh: 你不會有禮貌？我該擔心嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong pays, still unsure if you just thanked her or warned her.
story.zh: 王經理付了錢，還是不確定你剛剛是在道謝，還是在警告她。

fail.why: 「那我就不客氣了」直譯成 I won't be polite，聽起來像「我要對你不禮貌了」。說 That's very kind of you. Thank you! 就好。

lines.en: My pleasure. Next time, I want to hear more about Cedar Trail.
lines.zh: 不客氣。下次我想多聽聽雪松步道的事。

lines.en: Thanks, you two! Have a great afternoon!
lines.zh: 謝謝兩位！祝你們下午愉快！

story.en: You talked about hiking, kids and the city, and nobody mentioned email. Walking back, Ms. Wong feels less like a boss and more like a friendly guide.
story.zh: 你們聊了爬山、小孩和這座城市，沒有人提到工作信件。走回公司的路上，王經理不像是主管，更像一位親切的嚮導。

notes.explain: 這裡的 find 是「覺得、感受」，常用來問新環境或新工作。回答時說感受和具體例子，例如 I'm really enjoying it.。

example.en: How are you finding the new job?

notes.explain: -ed 描述人的感受，-ing 描述讓人有這種感受的事物。I'm tired 是「我很累」，I'm tiring 是「我很累人」。同樣的還有 bored／boring、interested／interesting。

example.en: The trip was tiring, so I'm really tired today.
example.zh: 這趟旅程很累人，所以我今天很累。

notes.explain: 別人請客、送禮或幫忙時的得體回應，比單說 thank you 更有溫度，對主管、客戶都適用。

example.en: You saved me a seat? That's very kind of you.
example.zh: 你幫我留了位子？你真是太好了。

notes.zh: 那我就不客氣了。（直譯陷阱）
notes.explain: 中文「不客氣」是大方接受的意思，但 I won't be polite 在英文是「我不會有禮貌」，聽起來像要吵架。接受好意說 Thank you, that's very kind of you. 或 Don't mind if I do.。

example.en: More cake? Don't mind if I do!
example.zh: 再來一塊蛋糕？那我就不客氣了！

notes.explain: 和主管閒聊時，興趣、旅行、城市、美食都是安全話題。收入、年齡、婚姻、生育計畫則很私人，在很多英語系文化連親戚都不太問。對方主動提起時，順著聊就好，不要追問細節。

example.en: Have you tried any good restaurants around here?
example.zh: 你在附近有吃過什麼好餐廳嗎？
